intents.name: battery_drain
intents.description: Customer complaining about fast battery depletion, battery draining quickly after update, or poor battery life.
example_messages: My battery drains from 100% to 20% in two hours after updating to iOS 11.
@AppleSupport #ios11update - is still killing my battery within 12 hours - phone is 10 months old
Took my phone off charge at 7:20am. 8:03am - 60% battery remaining.

intents.name: system_performance_lag
intents.description: Customer reporting general slowness, UI lag, unresponsive screen, or phone running extremely slow.
example_messages: My phone is so laggy and unresponsive since the last patch.
ios is too slow on iphone6 and i am not happy with it. Any solution please?
My apps stop working without warning and my phone freezes every five minutes!

intents.name: app_crash_bug
intents.description: Customer reporting specific apps crashing, closing unexpectedly, or failing to launch.
example_messages: WhatsApp and Instagram keep closing on their own as soon as I open them.
apps now frequently crash after the new update.
after the 11.0.2 my phone just sucks most of the apps are broken

intents.name: verification_code_issue
intents.description: Customer experiencing problems with account codes, 2FA, iStore passcodes, or message rate limits.
example_messages: I need a new code for my iStore. I haven't received any but message says too many sent.
Not receiving 2FA security code to log into my Apple ID.
Code for verification isn't arriving on my SMS.

intents.name: playback_audio_issue
intents.description: Customer experiencing problems with music playback, bluetooth audio, or background audio stopping.
example_messages: So the new update does not let me listen to music and go on whatsapp at the same time?!?
Apple Music stops playing whenever I lock my screen.
Bluetooth audio keeps cutting out when playing songs.

intents.name: update_rollback_request
intents.description: Customer asking how to downgrade or revert back to a previous version of iOS.
example_messages: Can you get my iPhone 7plus back on the old iOS please?
How do I uninstall iOS 11 and go back to iOS 10?
Is there any way to downgrade my iPhone to the previous stable release?

intents.name: general_complaint_feedback
intents.description: Customer venting dissatisfaction, anger, or general frustration about Apple products/updates without a single specific technical symptom.
example_messages: @AppleSupport fix this update. It's horrible
You've paralysed my phone with your update grrrrrrrrrr
I really hope you all change but I'm sure you won't!

intents.name: other
intents.description: Out of scope customer inquiry, product inquiries, hardware repair status, trade-in, or unclassified messages.
example_messages: What are the store hours for the Apple Store in downtown Chicago?
How much does it cost to replace an iPhone screen?
Can I trade in my old iPad for credit?
